entries.title: Proverbs 3:2
segments: A prosperous and happy life is the reward of obeying God's commandments.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:3
segments:
Mercy and truth; these include all true goodness. 
 
  Bind them about thy neck; as the noblest ornament. 
 
  Write them upon the table of thy heart; that they may always remain there.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:4
segments:
In the sight of God and man; thy good understanding shall be manifest to God and man, and gain for thee their favor. 
 
The possession of true wisdom secures the premanent favor of God and all good men.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:6
segments:
Acknowledge him; feel thy dependence upon him and seek his direction. 
 
They who feel their need of God's protection and guidance, and humbly commit themselves to him in the way of duty, shall not be left to perplexity or error.  He will mark out their path for them, and make them truly prosperous and useful.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:8
segments:
Navel--bones; put for the whole body. 
 
  Marrow to thy bones; making them strong and vigorous.  Bodily health is here put for prosperity of every kind, temporal and spiritual. 
 
True health of soul and body lies in fearing God and departing from evil.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:9
segments:
Honor the Lord with thy substance; by giving to his service the due portion. 
 
  First-fruits; which the Israelites were required to offer to God.
When we honor God with our property, he will bless us in the possession and use of it.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:12
segments: God chastens his children because he loves them, and purposes to make them meet for eternal glory.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:14
segments: The merchandise of it; the gaining of it by traffic.  Wisdom is here regarded as a precious treasure, to be gained at whatever cost. Compare

entries.title: Proverbs 3:15
segments: The smallest measure of true wisdom is better than all the kingdoms of the world and the glory of them; for it makes us blessed here, and prepares us for eternal blessedness hereafter.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:16
segments: Her right hand--her left hand; she dispenses blessings to her followers from both hands.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:18
segments: A tree of life; she gives life to them that receive her instruction.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:19
segments: Hath founded--the heavens; the crowning praise of wisdom: by her God hath created the world.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:20
segments:
Depths; subterranean abysses. 
 
  Broken up; made to gush forth.  Some understand these words of the division of the great deep, into the waters under the firmament, and the waters above the firmament.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:25
segments: Be not afraid; that is, when thou keepest sound wisdom and discretion.

Sudden fear; sudden destruction from God, which overwhelms the wicked with fear. 
 
It is not only the privilege, but the duty of the righteous to be composed and free from fear amidst those judgments which destroy God's enemies.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:27
segments: All who need our help have a claim upon us from God for it.  We should give it promptly and cheerfully, and thank him for the opportunity.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:31
segments: The oppressor; because of his present success in sinful practices.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:32
segments: Secret; intimate friendship.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:33
segments: They who provide for their families wealth and power by wicked practices, lay up for them a curse instead of a blessing.  God's favor bestowed upon the children of the righteous is better than houses full of silver and gold.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:34
segments: It is the unchangeable purpose of God to abase the proud and exalt the humble; and he is abundantly able to accomplish it in respect to nations, families, and individuals.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:35
segments: Shame shall be the promotion of fools; while the wise are promoted to true glory, the only promotion of fools shall be shame; that is, they shall have shame instead of glory.
